claim: The shipped wasm is built at opt-level s, not the z that [profile.release] states; the Cargo.toml comment on [profile.wasm-release] says so.
actual: Cargo.toml [profile.release] says opt-level = "z" (line 47); Cargo.toml defines no [profile.wasm-release] (the comment lives above [profile.server-release], lines 54-66, and says dx synthesises wasm-release with opt-level "s"); no Dioxus.toml (preview/Dioxus.toml has only [application] and [web.app]), no .cargo/config and no script sets CARGO_PROFILE or RUSTFLAGS for the build. The dx 0.7.9 binary contains the literal injection `.strip=false.inherits="".opt-level="s".lto=true.debug=true`. So s applies via dx's synthesised profile (static evidence; I did not capture a live rustc command line, and could not invert the cargo fingerprint hash). The report's wording about a [profile.wasm-release] comment is wrong.

receipts.text:
# Do NOT add a `[profile.wasm-release]` here without re-deriving the shipped wasm settings: dx

claim: Dialog: wasm memory 20.3 -> 24.3 MB over 700 open/close cycles, linear, no plateau (5.7 KB/cycle).
actual: Own soak, 1500 cycles, local docs/ and deployed: 20.25 -> 22.94 MB over 1500 cycles (+2.69 MB, 1.75 KB/cycle; deployed 600 cycles identical to the local numbers, 20.25 -> 21.38). At cycle 700 it is 21.56 MB (+1.3 MB), not +4.0 MB: magnitude about 3x lower than reported. Shape reproduced: slope 1.82 KB/cycle in the first half and 1.77 in the second, no plateau, so growth is continuous (not a one-time allocator high-water mark). JS heap after forced GC also rises 3.91 -> 6.86 MB, DOM nodes constant 6,531, listeners flat 107.

claim: Combobox leaks about +1 DOM node per cycle (10,544 -> 10,923 over 350 cycles), linear.
actual: CDP node counter does rise +1/cycle for the first ~330 cycles (10,605 -> 10,936) but then PLATEAUS at 10,936 through cycle 1500, listeners flat at 150, and document.querySelectorAll('*') is constant at 5,213; a 200-cycle diff of every attached node (elements, text, comments) shows only option ids dxc-c0..c6 replaced by dxc-c14..c20 (ids come from a counter), no net change. A heap snapshot diff attributes the growth to Chromium's editing undo stack (blink::UndoStep +600, InsertIntoTextNodeCommand +400, native Text +200 per 200 cycles), and a plain <input> page with no Dioxus, same keystrokes (type, Ctrl+A, Backspace, Escape), grows 1.01 node/cycle. There is no combobox DOM node to trace to Rust source: no accumulating node exists in the app.

claim: (Implied) the wasm growth is specific to dialog and combobox.
actual: Not specific: dropdown_menu grows 21.38 -> 22.81 MB over 500 cycles (3.0 KB/cycle, linear), popover is flat for ~300 cycles then 19.31 -> 19.44 MB by 500 (0.25 KB/cycle average, too short to call; second half 0.67 KB/cycle). The growth is shared by overlay components (open/close cycles), not a dialog/combobox-only bug.

claim: (Cause of growth) JS heap rises with every open/close cycle; report says decelerating.
actual: JS heap after forced GC rises 3.91 -> 6.86 MB over 1500 dialog cycles (linear, not decelerating). Part of it is unbounded user-timing entries: tracing-wasm (pulled in by the 'logger' feature of dioxus in the release preview crate) calls performance.mark/measure on every tracing span/event; the page holds 48 marks + 48 measures per dialog cycle (677 -> 1,637 entries in 20 cycles) and 190+190 per combobox cycle; heap snapshot shows PerformanceMark/Measure +9,600 per 200 dialog cycles. Stubbing performance.mark/measure lowers the JS heap at cycle 1500 from 6.86 to 5.98 MB but leaves wasm growth unchanged (22.94 MB both), so wasm growth has another, unidentified, Rust-side cause (not isolated).
